summary.text: Vicki Doudera is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 41, Knox County, representing Camden and Rockport.
The page lists Vicki Doudera as chair of the Environment and Natural Resources committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Vicki Doudera's education as Hamilton College (BA, 1983).
The page lists Vicki Doudera's occupation as Realtor and Writer.
Listed affiliations include Phi Sigma Iota; Foreign Language; National Honor Society, Vice President Midcoast Habitat for Humanity.
Vicki Doudera lives in Camden and has served 4 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Committee assignments listed: Environment and Natural Resources (chair).
Family details on the page: 3 children, 3 grandchildren.
